title: Thai Harees Curry
description: A Thai-inspired twist on traditional harees, featuring a warm and silky curry sauce made with wheat and a hint of eastern spices. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and sauté until softened.
Add curry paste and stir for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk and stir to combine.
Add harees and wheat and stir to coat with curry sauce.
Add fish sauce and sugar and stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in lemon juice and serve hot.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
